scope: Author-created cases frozen before the structural transfer implementation; not an independent held-out benchmark.

families.problem: The supplied billing rule is quantity multiplied by price. Repair the function against the independent supplied check.
families.source:
def line_total(quantity, price):
    return quantity + price
families.transfer_problem: Compute a batch charge as units multiplied by rate. Negative units must be rejected. Repair against the supplied check.
families.negative_problem: This different batch rule requires units minus rate, with the same negative-unit guard. A remembered multiplication is wrong here.

families.problem: An account qualifies when its score is at least the threshold, including equality. Repair the supplied function and verify the check.
families.source:
def qualifies(score, threshold):
    return score > threshold
families.check:
def verify(implementation):
    assert implementation.qualifies(9, 9) is True
    assert implementation.qualifies(8, 9) is False
    assert implementation.qualifies(10, 9) is True
families.transfer_problem: A sensor is ready when measured level is at least the required level. Preserve the bool return and support equality. Repair against the current check.
families.negative_problem: This different sensor signals readiness only BELOW the required value. Repair against this current independent check; inclusive-above recall is wrong.
families.negative_check:
def verify(implementation):
    assert implementation.sensor_ready(4, 7) is True
    assert implementation.sensor_ready(7, 7) is False
    assert implementation.sensor_ready(9, 7) is False

families.problem: The gate opens only when both enabled and ready are true. Repair the supplied function against all four boolean combinations.
families.source:
def gate_open(enabled, ready):
    return enabled or ready
families.transfer_problem: A release is allowed only when both reviewed and approved are true. Preserve all boolean outcomes and repair against the supplied check.
families.negative_problem: This different release rule requires reviewed to be true AND approved to be false. Repair against the independent check; both-true recall is wrong.
